title: 第一卷 第7章 糊弄过去，上山打猎！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

因此什么罪名都往他的头上安！

“那就带路去那家猎户看看。”

见周德厚一副确凿无疑的样子！

完颜木里也懒得说什么了！

“遵命！”

周德厚一听说动了金人老爷，面上也是一喜。

似乎已经看见了秦云死在金人老爷刀下的场景，兴高采烈的在前头带路。

村里的其他人也都跟在队列之后，打算看看今天这件事情会怎么发展。

此时，秦云依然是一副没事人的样子！

他的母亲秦王氏吃了药又喝了肉汤，到今天气色已经好转了不少，此时正靠在床上歇着。

赵佛儿则是在灶台前忙活，把昨天没吃完的那些熊肉又热了热！

他则抽出空来，把门前的积雪全都打扫干净了！

而后便坐在门槛上琢磨手里的唯一一副弓箭！

经过昨日的打猎，他发现手里的长弓磅数太低了，用得很是不顺手！

要知道，他在蓝星时也极为擅长射箭，但那时用的乃是现代复合弓！

一箭下去即便是狮子也能射个对穿！

“得找个机会，把复合弓打造出来啊！”

秦云下定了决心！

在这种战乱末世之中，必须得有些超越时代的武器，才能拥有超越常人的武力保护自己以及家人！

虽说那种现代复合弓他目前没材料打造不出来！

但比较传统的复合弓还是没问题的！

就在这时！

赵佛儿第一时间看见，有一大群人乌泱乌泱地朝着他们家这边走来。

“官人，有好多人往我们这边来了。”

赵佛儿停下手中的动作，扭头看向坐在门槛上打理弓箭的秦云。

秦云听见赵佛儿的话后，心里并没有什么波澜！

似乎早知道周德厚会把目标锁定在他的身上。

“没你什么事情，你进屋陪娘，把门关上，除了我叫门，不管外面发生什么事情，都不要开门。”

秦云叮嘱过后！

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

Therefore, all charges are placed on his head!

"Then lead the way to that Orion house and have a look."

See Zhou Dehou looking confident!

Wanyan Muli was too lazy to say anything!

"As you command!"

When Zhou Dehou heard that the Jin man had been moved, his face was also happy.

It seemed that he had already seen the scene of Qin Yun dying under the sword of Master Jin, and he happily led the way.

Others in the village also followed the queue, intending to see how this matter would develop today.

At this time, Qin Yun still looked like he was fine!

His mother, Prince Qin, took medicine and drank broth. Today her complexion has improved a lot and she is resting on the bed.

Zhao Foer was busy in front of the stove, reheating the bear meat that he had not eaten yesterday!

He took some time out and swept away all the snow in front of the door!

Then he sat on the threshold and pondered the only bow and arrow in his hand!

After yesterday's hunting, he found that the weight of the longbow in his hand was too low, making it difficult to use!

You know, he was also very good at archery when he was at Blue Star, but he used a modern compound bow at that time!

Even a lion can be shot through with one arrow!

"I have to find an opportunity to make a compound bow!"

Qin Yun made up his mind!

In this war-torn apocalypse, you must have some weapons that transcend the times in order to protect yourself and your family with force beyond ordinary people!

Although he currently doesn’t have the materials to make a modern compound bow!

But the more traditional compound bow is still fine!

Right now!

Zhao Foer immediately saw a large group of people walking towards their house.

"Sir, there are many people coming to us."

Zhao Fo'er stopped what he was doing and turned to look at Qin Yun, who was sitting on the threshold taking care of his bow and arrows.

After Qin Yun heard Zhao Foer's words, he didn't feel any disturbance in his heart!

It seemed that he had known that Zhou Dehou would target him.

"It's nothing for you. You go into the house to accompany your mother and close the door. Unless I call the door, no matter what happens outside, don't open the door."

After Qin Yun’s instructions!
